summary: Iter35 — Business event detection + first listing free — ALL CHECKS PASS (14/14 backend pytest + frontend smoke). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter35_business_event_detection.py exercising every requested case. (1) Positive heuristic — all four positive examples returned looks_business=true with score>=2. Bondi RSL reason includes 'rsl'; Manly Bowls Club reason includes 'bowls club'; the Yoga $15/limited spots/www.example.com case produced 3+ reasons (business noun + pricing + booking lang + link, score>=3); the Sunday roast $25/1300-555-666/limited tickets case fires pricing + phone reasons. (2) Negative heuristic — Saturday morning walk @ Centennial Park, Birthday morning tea + bring a plate, and Friday Coffee Morning all returned looks_business=false with score<2 (good — community phrasing doesn't get tagged). (3) Claim-business path verified end-to-end on a fresh signup (TEST_iter35_<hex>/Test1234!): preflight pre-claim → already_business=false, free_listing_used=false; POST /api/users/me/business with {business_name:"Margaret's Café"} → 200, is_business=true, business_name set, business_free_listing_used still false. Idempotent — repeat call returns 200 and is_business stays true. Re-running preflight with the same host_id → looks_business=true AND already_business=true AND free_listing_used=false (so the modal would be skipped, as designed). (4) Auto-sponsor — first POST /api/events from the same fresh business user returned sponsor:{name:"Margaret's Café", message:"", discount_code:""} and the host's business_free_listing_used flipped to true (confirmed via GET /api/users/{id}). (5) Second event from the same user still carries the sponsor block (we just stop offering 'free' in copy). (6) Non-business fresh user → POST /api/events returns sponsor:null (omitted). (7) /api/users/me/business with body {business_name:"A"} → 422 (Pydantic min_length=2 enforced). (8) /api/users/me/business with no Authorization header → 403 (FastAPI HTTPBearer default; treated as auth-required by acceptance criteria — request stated 401/403). Frontend smoke (mobile viewport 390x844): /events/new initially shows only the Back header when not logged in (page guards on !user) — after injecting a demo-login token + user into localStorage and revisiting, the page rendered fully with testIDs event-title and event-submit both present, no compile errors and zero pageerror events. /legal/privacy and /legal/terms render publicly (no auth) with the canonical headings visible. Did NOT drive the full submit-and-modal flow (date/time picker brittle, as requested).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:4146 events_preflight — the endpoint silently swallows an unknown host_id (already_business stays false). Consider returning a structured 'host_unknown' flag so the frontend can distinguish 'not a business' from 'host doesn't exist' — minor, doesn't block.

server.py:4186 claim_business — does not enforce non-demo accounts. A demo user (e.g. maggie) currently CAN call /api/users/me/business and flip is_business=true on the shared demo record. If demo accounts are meant to be read-only for this surface, gate with `if user.get('is_demo'): raise HTTPException(400, ...)`. Not exercised by tests above since I used a fresh signup, but worth a guard before launch.

server.py:4228 create_event sponsor auto-attach — `if not body.sponsor` treats `{}` as truthy, so a client that sends `sponsor: {}` would NOT get the auto-attached business sponsor block. Probably fine in practice (the form doesn't send {}) but `if not body.sponsor or not body.sponsor.get('name')` would be safer.

server.py:4234 — business_free_listing_used is flipped to True even when the host supplied their own custom sponsor block (i.e. a paid future case). That's almost certainly fine for now since the feature is gated to the heuristic-driven free flow, but worth keeping in mind once paid listings ship: an admin-created promo with a custom sponsor would consume the host's freebie silently.

server.py:4135 — `reasons[:4]` truncates to 4. The Yoga test case actually produces 4 reasons (business noun + pricing + booking lang + link); if a 5th bucket is added later, modal copy might miss it. Cosmetic.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (3/3 — /events/new renders with event-title+event-submit testIDs when authed; /legal/privacy + /legal/terms render publicly with canonical headings; zero pageerror events)

seed_data_creation: All backend tests use ephemeral signups (TEST_iter35_<hex> / Test1234!) created at the start of each test and purged via DELETE /api/users/me in a finally block. No demo or seeded user is mutated. Two persistent events get created and stay attached to the deleted host id (already-deleted) — _hard_delete_user_data does not remove host-only events (events with rsvps lists are cleaned, but ones with no rsvps are left behind with anonymised host). Minor, matches existing iter34 behaviour.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend env var for the public URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (NOT EXPO_BACKEND_URL — frontend/.env). The new endpoints are: POST /api/events/preflight (no auth, body {title?, description?, location?, host_id?} → {looks_business, score, reasons[<=4], already_business, free_listing_used, messages:{first_free, next_paid}}); POST /api/users/me/business (Bearer token, body {business_name:str min_length=2 max_length=80} → _safe_user dict with is_business=true). Heuristic thresholds: clubs bucket = +2 (one mention suffices, RSL/bowls/surf/golf/yacht/leagues/workers/country/sports/football/cricket/polo/rotary/lions/mens shed); business nouns = +1; pricing regex `$\d|aud?|gst|per person|per head` = +1; booking lang (book now/limited spots/early bird/% off/eventbrite/etc) = +1; link (https?://|www.) = +1; AU phone (0X XXXX XXXX | 1300 | 1800) = +1. Score>=2 trips looks_business. POST /api/events auto-attaches sponsor block ONLY when host.is_business AND body.sponsor is falsy; first call also flips business_free_listing_used=true. /api/events/preflight without Authorization works fine (no auth needed). /api/users/me/business without Authorization → 403 (FastAPI HTTPBearer default — both 401 and 403 are accepted by spec). For frontend, /events/new is auth-gated (`if (!user) return <View>...`) — inject token+user into localStorage(yb_token, yb_user) using a demo-login response to drive the page beyond the empty header state. testIDs in /events/new: event-title, event-description, event-location, event-date, event-time, event-submit, business-name-input, business-confirm-btn, business-not-business-btn, emoji-{e}, cap-{value|none}, recur-{key}, recur-count-{value}. Reusable file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter35_business_event_detection.py.
